sets.title: SOD1 activity map score set
sets.experiment_title: Landscapes of missense variant impact for human SOD1
sets.experiment_method: Libraries were generated using Tag-POPCode with and without GFP linked to SOD1, for the SOD1 activity and abundance map, respectively. The activity map in yeast was generated using transformation of the SOD1 library and the select condition was temperature restriction. The abundance map in HEK293 cells was generated using integration of the SOD1-GFP library into the Bxb1 site and abundant variants selected for via high GFP and mCherry+ integration marker cell sorting. DNA was extracted and sequencing performed using Tile-Seq and Illumina short-read between the nonselect and select conditions. Analysis was performed using the tileseqMut and tileseqMAVE pipelines.
